name: Izumi Tomohiro
source:
The protagonist, who never sticks out in class.
In a stroke of bad luck, he was appointed by lottery as the student council president and finds himself suddenly the center of attention.

[From the [url=https://madosoft.net/hamidashi/character]official website[/url]]

He once reached top three and considers himself a top ranker in the game Sengoku Delation, which he used to frequently whale on using [url=https://vndb.org/c87837]Hiyori[/url]'s money.
